categories.main_business_segments: Boyaa Interactive International Limited operates primarily in two segments: the traditional online game business focusing on mobile and web-based card and board games, and the Web3 related business involving cryptocurrency investments and development of Web3 game products and infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages traditional online game development technologies for card and board games, while actively investing in blockchain and Web3 technologies including crypto asset management, Web3 game development, and related infrastructure such as Web3 wallets and DeFi platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Boyaa serves online game players globally, with a focus on Asia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. Its customers include individual gamers participating in online card and board games and users of Web3 gaming platforms and digital asset services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia (including Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam), the Middle East, and Europe, with subsidiaries and operations spread across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Boyaa operates primarily at the midstream and downstream points of the supply chain, developing and operating online games and Web3 platforms, while also holding upstream cryptocurrency assets as part of its investment and operational strategy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on steady growth of traditional online games and aggressive expansion into Web3 through R&D, investment, and incubation of Web3 projects, including game products and infrastructure. The company prioritizes innovation in gameplay, user experience, and blockchain integration to build industry-leading Web3 games.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through online game operations including mobile and web-based games, value-added in-game services, and digital asset appreciation from cryptocurrency holdings. The company also earns from digital asset management rewards and investment gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Boyaa positions itself as a leading player in online card and board games and aims to become a pure and leading Web3 listed company, leveraging its cryptocurrency reserves and Web3 investments to differentiate itself in the gaming and blockchain sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Boyaa reported revenue of approximately RMB456.9 million, a 15.8% increase year-on-year, and an unaudited non-IFRS adjusted net profit of RMB886.3 million, up 645.2% mainly due to cryptocurrency fair value gains. The company holds over 3,300 Bitcoin units and nearly 300 Ethereum units, reflecting significant growth and scale in digital assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Boyaa emphasizes high-quality, innovative card and board game products combined with pioneering Web3 game development and infrastructure. Its unique value lies in integrating traditional gaming with blockchain technology, supported by substantial cryptocurrency reserves, to offer enhanced user experiences and diversified revenue streams.
